value.rationale: Exact variance-safe training shrinkage is motivated by the previously established infinite second moment of ordinary balanced split e-values. The analysis supplies a sharp admissible regularization frontier, quantifies the vanishing variance reduction from swapping halves in the only bounded-second-moment high-dimensional scale, and measures the oracle log-growth tradeoff. This is a natural statistical stability question, not a chosen numerical slice. It does not claim power optimality.
